Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Popliteal fossada baker kisti.

In the medial compartment, there is complex tear (main radial component) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse high grade and low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Few subchondral bone cysts (about intact3 cm) are present. Osteophytes are present. 
  
 The lateral compartment, there is suspected radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis along weightbaring, non weightbaring lateral femoral condyle lateral tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial and lateral trochleas, medial and lateral patellar facets. There is no subchondral edema. Few subchondral bone cysts (about intact2 cm) are identified. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is suspicious chronic partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal. 
   
 Some amount of right knee effusion with synovitis is present. There are no loose bodies. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Moderate to severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
  Complex tear (main radial component) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
  Suspected radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. 
  Some amount of right knee effusion with synovitis.

Findings: No evidence of knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism. The patella is mildly high lying. No evidence of patellar maltracking.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: No significant abnormality.

Medial menisküs posterior hornunda grade II   ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmektedir.Arka çapraz bağ,ön çapraz bağ , lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellada subkondral milimetrik kist ve kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Popliteal fossada 50x7 mm boyutlarında baker kisti ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.

Kuadriseps yağ yastığındaki hafif ödem ön diz ağrısı nedeni olabilir. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Mediyal menisküs arka boynuzundaki dejenerasyona arka boynuzu - gövdesi düzeyinde üst ve alt eklem yüzeyleri ile ilişkilenen kompleks yırtık eşlik ediyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Ön çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyonu düzeyindeki parsiyel yırtık bağ kalınlığın en çok %50'sini ilgilendiriyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Semimembranozus (SM) tendonunun insersiyonunda hafif dereceli tendonozis izleniyor. Posteriyor oblik (POL), oblik popliteal bağlar (OPL) ödemli. Posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında korunmuş. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

No evidence of knee effusion. There is complex tearing of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: Complex tearing of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. No ligamentous injury.

Erhaltene Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Kortikale Impressionen/Irregularitäten und fokales subkortikales Ödem und kleinzystische Veränderungen der lateralen Patellafacette und des Patellafirst (siehe z. B. 3/42) im mittleren Patella-Drittel. Ansonsten unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Patella zentriert stehend. Nachweis einer fokalen chondralen Delamination mit einem Knorpeldefekt von ca ml 15 x ap 4 x cc 13 mm. Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt keine Dislokation von Knorpelfragmenten, keine freien Gelenkkörper. Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung des übrigen Knorpelbelags im rechten Kniegelenk. Unauffällige Darstellung der menisci und der Kreuzbänder. Kollateralbandapparat intakt. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit, auch in Baker-Position.
Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und der Subkutis

Subluxación patelar. Meniscopatía medial.

posterior del menisco medial con segmento desplazado en "asa de balde" a la región
intercondílea. El remanente a nivel del cuerpo y cuerno posterior también presenta una rotura
